title: Read review
text: Read review. If you have any type of back pain, disabled, or elderly-you may want to think twice before you buy this. I should've bought one that zipped on both sides. I had to put my Queen comforter in the cover and work it around from one side to the next until I got it straightened out. It was very difficult & my back was screaming when I finished. It still has some bunched up spots. Im actually thinking of return it because I can't do this every time that I wash my sheets.
